apps.name: E3Sm Scream
apps.description:
E3SM EAMxx / SCREAM — the C++/Kokkos rewrite of E3SM's atmosphere physics
(P3 microphysics, SHOC turbulence, RRTMGP radiation, etc.), GPU-portable via
Kokkos. INCITE-demanded climate code (5 proposals), no prior Polaris recipe.
This is a STANDALONE library build of components/eamxx driven directly by
CMake — deliberately NOT the CIME case / test-all-eamxx wrapper, which would
require porting a CIME machine config for Polaris (out of scope for a first
build). E3SM's own committed machine file cmake/machine-files/polaris.cmake
supplies the compiler + Kokkos config (it includes EKAT's nvidia-a100.cmake =>
Kokkos_ARCH_AMPERE80 + CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=80, and cuda.cmake =>
Kokkos_ENABLE_CUDA + CUDA_LAMBDA). Adapted from the WarpX/Polaris Kokkos-CUDA
sibling (software/polaris/warpx.yaml) for the toolchain + nvcc-MPI lessons.
